# Giulia Dal Bon

> Hand-painted murals and painting lessons. Giulia Dal Bon is a painter and mural artist trained at the Accademia di Belle Arti di Brera in Milan. She is based in Menton, France, and takes commissions across the French Riviera, Monaco, Liguria, Lombardy and Piedmont. She also travels for commissioned projects elsewhere on request.

Site available in three languages: Italian at the root, French under /fr/, English under /en/.

## Facts

- Name: Giulia Dal Bon
- Discipline: mural painting, commissioned portraits, painted landscapes, live painting
- Training: Accademia di Belle Arti di Brera, Milan
- Base: Menton, Alpes-Maritimes, France
- Regular service area: Menton, Monaco, Nice, Cannes, Roquebrune-Cap-Martin, Saint-Jean-Cap-Ferrat, Saint-Tropez, Antibes, Beaulieu-sur-Mer, Ventimiglia, Bordighera, Sanremo, Genoa, Portofino, Gulf of Poets, Milan, Monza, Segrate, Bergamo, Lake Como, Bellagio, Varenna, Lake Maggiore, Turin, Cuneo, Alba
- Travel: available for commissioned mural projects outside this area; travel and logistics agreed per commission
- Techniques: watercolour, acrylic, drawing, digital sketching (Procreate, Illustrator, Photoshop)
- Languages spoken: Italian, French, English
- Contact: WhatsApp and email, listed on every page of the site

## Press coverage

Giulia Dal Bon painted a mural of over 20 metres dedicated to Giorgio Gaber and Enzo Jannacci, inaugurated on 16 October 2024 at Circolo Cerizza, via Meucci 4, Milan. Coverage:

- Il Giorno: https://www.ilgiorno.it/milano/cultura/murales-gaber-jannacci-lxro3ed3
- Artuu Magazine (interview): https://www.artuu.it/a-milano-un-murales-dedicato-a-gaber-e-jannacci-intervista-allartista-e-alla-figlia-del-cantautore/
- MilanoToday: https://www.milanotoday.it/eventi/murales-fondazione-gaber.html
- Mentelocale: https://www.mentelocale.it/milano/59694-a-milano-un-murale-per-gaber-e-jannacci-ecco-dove-si-trova.htm
- Revenews: https://www.revenews.it/arte-contemporanea/street-art/2024/10/18/gaber-e-jannacci-diventano-protagonisti-di-un-nuovo-murale-nella-loro-milano/
- Giornale di Segrate: https://giornaledisegrate.it/2024/10/17/un-murales-per-gaber-e-jannacci-la-firma-e-di-unartista-segratese/

Born 1997. Trained at the Accademia di Belle Arti di Brera, Milan. Now based in Menton, France, and available for commissioned work.

## What the service is called

The same service is known under several names, and Giulia offers all of them:
mural, wall mural, hand-painted wall, wall painting, decorative painting, trompe-l'oeil.
Italian: murales su commissione, dipinti murali, decorazione pareti, pittura murale, affresco, trompe l'oeil.
French: fresque murale, peinture murale, decor mural, decoration murale, peinture decorative, trompe-l'oeil.
Everything is painted by hand in acrylic. No printing, no wallpaper, no stickers.

## Pricing

Small mural from 450 EUR. Medium mural from 900 EUR. Larger surfaces on request.
Free quote within 48 hours. Send a photo of the wall, its approximate dimensions and the idea.
